title: L'Atmosphère

technical.vocal_stem_note: Lead and backing vocal stems are effectively silent; only negligible tail/noise energy is present.

structural_markers.character: Immediate unresolved handoff; bass/guitar/synth entrance with restrained percussion.
Texture thins; guitar-led tension and suspended space.
Bass, strings and rhythm gather into purposeful forward movement.
Full rhythmic system locks in; drums/bass/strings carry mechanical inevitability.
Strongest sustained coordination; brass appears around the middle of the passage.
High-drive exterior expansion with persistent drums and bass.
Rhythm opens and thins to keyboard/percussion/bass, leaving room for the public proof.
Unresolved keyboard/synth/bass tail; drums recede without a hard stop.

mix_policy.master_authority: The full mix is the editorial score authority.
stems_use: Create smooth dialogue or system-sound space without hard muting the score.
Preserve bass/drums continuity across visual cuts.
Use local stem automation only with smooth ramps.
Do not replace the score with generated video audio.
mix_policy.generated_audio_classification: Generated video audio defaults to isolate_sfx or discard; dialogue and music are not accepted from image-to-video output.

analysis_method: Programmatic duration, level, onset, spectral and per-stem activity analysis; structural markers chosen from contiguous timbral/activity changes and checked against the eight-shot storyboard.
